# Unite Group

> Unite Group (Unite-Group Nexus Pty Ltd) is an online business serving Australia and New Zealand. It is an AI marketing agency, with Margot as its AI face. Available now, ask us to start: the Starter plan, email signatures as an add-on, and the video business card (one link or QR code that plays a short film ending on your logo, then shows your details and saves to contacts in one tap).

## What we offer

- Video business card, Ready-made: $249 AUD, one-off price, GST included. You pick one of the ready-made films and it ends on your logo and details.
- Video business card, Made for you: $449 AUD, one-off price, GST included. We make a film for your business and you approve a private proof before it goes live.
- Starter plan: $99 AUD a month. Email signatures: $22 AUD each, an add-on. Both exclude GST; ask us to start. Details at https://unite-group.in/pricing
- The example films on the showroom are AI-generated and labelled as such.
- Hosting is 12 months from the day the card goes live, with no monthly fee. The full wording is at https://unite-group.in/cards/terms
